name: Penetrating Spell (Metamagic)
body:
Your spells can overcome energy resistance.

Benefit: Damage dealt by a penetrating spell is dealt to a creature as if it did not have the energy resistance universal monster ability (it takes all of the damage even if it normally has an energy resistance which would protect it.)

Level Increase: +1 (a penetrating spell uses a spell slot 1 level higher than the spell’s actual level.)
